lesson: The probe signal and the diagonal class sit in the symmetric (Frobenius plus Verschiebung) part of the graph classes, where the Hodge form reads only reality of alpha + q/alpha. The Weil bound sits in the antisymmetric part, which the signal does not meet. A squared pairing equals a norm only in rank 1 (genus 1). At N = 1 the test is one inequality per L-polynomial, and it was largely decided by c10 4(c) and its referee's correction 5.
